headline: Renesas engineer presents a concrete UVM-MS DAC verification component
fact: At Verification Futures UK 2025, Renesas engineer Steve Holloway presented a concrete example of creating a DAC verification component using the new UVM-MS methodology. The published session description identifies the verification-component architecture and code snippets as key content. This is a public UVM-MS implementation example from a Renesas engineer, not evidence of company-wide or product-wide deployment.

sources.title: UVM-MS: A Concrete Example using a DAC
sources.summary: Tessolve's session page identifies Steve Holloway and describes creation of a DAC verification component using UVM-MS, including verification-component architecture and code snippets.
